name: Muhammad Kudarat
contribution: The 7th Sultan of Maguindanao from c. 1616 or c. 1619 to 1671.
legacy: During his reign, he successfully fought off Spanish invasions and halted the spread of Catholicism on the island of Mindanao, much like the other Muslim rulers in the southern Philippines.

checks.lead: Muhammad Dipatuan Kudarat (or Muhammad di-Pertuan Kudrat; Jawi: محمد دڤتوان كودرت; 1581–1671) was the 7th Sultan of Maguindanao from c. 1616 or c. 1619 to 1671.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
